phase_1.title: Phase 1 · KS-23M Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 23×75mmR (6.27 Gauge · Barrikada Steel Slug) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 85 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 85 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 510 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 10-groove bore and accelerates to 420 m/s (5400 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Twin-Bar Pump & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 3-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the KS-23M staged for its 25 RPM (heavy-bore manual pump) cadence.

zh.headline: 苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪：1971 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 苏联图拉兵工厂研制的 KS-23（“特种 23 毫米卡宾枪”）堪称军工暴力美学的传奇：直接将航空/高射 23mm 机炮因微疵淘汰的线膛炮管截短加工为手持泵动发射器，6.27 号巨口径发射“路障”钢芯弹可百米外一发洞穿汽车缸体。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：KS-23M 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1971 年问世的 苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 由苏联图拉兵工厂（TOZ）主导研制，定位为经典的23mm 航炮改制线膛防暴泵动枪。1970 年代苏联内务部急需一种能一击阻停车辆并驱散监狱暴动的特种枪械，设计师巧手将工厂堆积的 23mm 航炮次品管变废为宝，成就了一代“手持加农炮”。
苏联图拉兵工厂研制的 KS-23（“特种 23 毫米卡宾枪”）堪称军工暴力美学的传奇：直接将航空/高射 23mm 机炮因微疵淘汰的线膛炮管截短加工为手持泵动发射器，6.27 号巨口径发射“路障”钢芯弹可百米外一发洞穿汽车缸体。 整件装备总长 1,040 mm（枪托展开）、空重 3.85 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1971 年，苏联图拉兵工厂（TOZ）推出了划时代的苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪。1970 年代苏联内务部急需一种能一击阻停车辆并驱散监狱暴动的特种枪械，设计师巧手将工厂堆积的 23mm 航炮次品管变废为宝，成就了一代“手持加农炮”。 它的核心设计聚焦于直接利用 23mm 航炮/高炮线膛坯料改制，拥有全球最大军用泵动枪膛径，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「回转四突笋泵动闭锁 · 航炮废弃线膛管改制 · 3+1 管仓」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，护木双联动拉杆向后拉动枪机托架使闭锁楔块降落，完成抽抛与托弹上膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用高温发蓝锻造合金钢精加工而成。保留 10 条右旋深膛线，在俄国分类中严格界定为“特种线膛卡宾枪”，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 采用回转四突笋泵动闭锁 · 航炮废弃线膛管改制 · 3+1 管仓。在每个击发周期中，护木双联动拉杆向后拉动枪机托架使闭锁楔块降落，完成抽抛与托弹上膛。借助高温发蓝锻造合金钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了保留 10 条右旋深膛线，在俄国分类中严格界定为“特种线膛卡宾枪”。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 23×75mmR (6.27 Gauge · Barrikada Steel Slug) 弹药规格与 510 mm（23mm 10 条右旋航炮膛线 · 1:600 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 85 MPa，可赋予弹头 420 m/s 的出膛初速与 5,400 J 动能，有效作用距离达 150 米。
内膛技术特点方面，直接使用 23mm 高射机炮检验淘汰的 10 条右旋线膛废料枪管截短再加工，因此归类为卡宾枪。同时，四突笋回转闭锁枪机稳固锁住 23×75mmR 超大底缘弹壳膛压，令其在 25 发/分（重口径手动泵动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 510 毫米身管与 23×75mmR (6.27 Gauge · Barrikada Steel Slug) 口径，苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 实现了每秒 420 米的初速与 150 米有效射程。直接使用 23mm 高射机炮检验淘汰的 10 条右旋线膛废料枪管截短再加工，因此归类为卡宾枪，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 3 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与 37 mm 膛轴设计，苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 34.5 N·s 水平。兼容“路障”破引擎钢弹、“星光”闪光弹及“丁香”催泪榴弹全系弹种。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-80）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 3 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与出色的整体工效，兼容“路障”破引擎钢弹、“星光”闪光弹及“丁香”催泪榴弹全系弹种。欢迎在 BAY-80 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 苏联 KS-23M 23mm 特种防暴线膛卡宾霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the KS-23M
paragraphs: Introduced in 1971 by Tula Arms Plant (TOZ) in Soviet Union, the Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine emerged as a defining 23mm Rifled Special-Purpose Pump Carbine. Commissioned in the 1970s for Soviet MVD prison-riot and vehicle-stop duties, engineers ingeniously salvaged surplus 23mm cannon blanks to create a shoulder-fired powerhouse.

Born from Soviet industrial pragmatism, the Tula KS-23 repurposes rejected 23mm anti-aircraft autocannon barrels—complete with 10-groove rifling—into a 6.27-gauge pump carbine whose steel Barrikada slugs disable vehicle engine blocks at 100 meters. Measuring 1,040 mm (40.9 in Overall) at an unloaded weight of 3.85 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1971, Tula Arms Plant (TOZ) of Soviet Union introduced the Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine. Commissioned in the 1970s for Soviet MVD prison-riot and vehicle-stop duties, engineers ingeniously salvaged surplus 23mm cannon blanks to create a shoulder-fired powerhouse. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Built from cut-down 23mm aircraft autocannon barrels—an enormous 6.27-gauge bore — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine sits its Four-Lug Rotating-Bolt Pump Action · Repurposed 23mm AA Cannon Rifled Barrel. Throughout every firing cycle, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell, containing 85 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Ten-groove RH cannon rifling officially classifies it as a special carbine, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine relies on Four-Lug Rotating-Bolt Pump Action · Repurposed 23mm AA Cannon Rifled Barrel. During each cycle, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell. Machined from hot-salt blued forged alloy steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Ten-groove RH cannon rifling officially classifies it as a special carbine.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 23×75mmR (6.27 Gauge · Barrikada Steel Slug) with 510 mm (23mm 10-Groove RH AA-Cannon Rifled · 1:600 mm), the Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine develops 420 m/s muzzle velocity and 5,400 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 150 meters.

Internally, Machined from rejected 23mm anti-aircraft autocannon blanks retaining 10-groove RH rifling. Combined with its 25 RPM (heavy-bore manual pump) tempo, Four-lug rotating bolt locks solidly against high-impulse 23×75mmR loads, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 23×75mmR (6.27 Gauge · Barrikada Steel Slug) through its 510 millimeter bore, the Soviet TOZ KS-23M 23mm Special Carbine achieves 420 meters per second and 150 meters of effective reach. Machined from rejected 23mm anti-aircraft autocannon blanks retaining 10-groove RH rifling.

paragraphs: Fed by a 3-round under-barrel tubular magazine with a 37 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 34.5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Fires Barrikada engine-piercing steel slugs, Zvezda flashbangs, and gas canisters.
